items.t: Internal water pump failure mixing coolant and oil
items.job: Replace internal water pump (timing chain area), flush oil and coolant
items.note: Cost rises a lot if coolant reached the bearings and the engine must be replaced.

items.t: AWD power transfer unit leaks and overheating
items.job: Replace power transfer unit seals and refill fluid
items.note: If the transfer unit itself has failed and must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Transmission speed sensor faults
items.job: Replace transmission speed sensor
items.note: Price is for one sensor. Wiring faults or internal damage can add cost.

items.t: Transmission range sensor problems
items.job: Replace transmission range sensor and adjust

items.t: Brake booster diaphragm tear (extended warranty)
items.job: Replace brake booster
items.note: Ford extended coverage on this part. Ask a Ford dealer to check your VIN first.

items.t: Door ajar light stays on and drains the battery
items.job: Replace faulty door latch assembly
items.note: Price is per door.

items.t: MyFord Touch screen freezes or goes black
items.job: Update SYNC/MyFord Touch software
items.note: If the update does not fix it and the SYNC (APIM) module must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Front halfshaft can disconnect (recall)
items.job: Replace front halfshaft (CV axle)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front brake hoses can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace both front brake hoses and bleed brakes
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear brake hose can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace rear brake hose and bleed brakes
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Coolant leaking into the cylinders
items.job: Replace engine long block
items.note: Ask a Ford dealer about warranty or goodwill help. Used engines cost less but may carry the same flaw.

items.t: AWD intermediate shaft seal leak
items.job: Replace intermediate shaft / PTU seal and top off fluid

items.t: Torque converter studs can break (recall)
items.job: Remove transmission and replace torque converter
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Shifter cable bushing can come apart (recall)
items.job: Replace shift cable bushing and add cap
items.note: Free under recall 22V-413. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering motor bolts can corrode (recall)
items.job: Replace steering gear motor bolts or steering gear
items.note: Free under recall 19V-632 / 15V-250. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transmission fluid leak from start-stop accumulator (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace start-stop accumulator bolts
items.note: Free under recall 20V-550. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera image blank or stuck on (recalls)
items.job: Update software or replace rear camera
items.note: Free under recall 25V-442 / 20V-575. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver seat belt anchor may be badly crimped (recall)
items.job: Replace driver seat belt pretensioner
items.note: Free under recall 19V-766. Check the VIN first.

items.t: AWD rear drive unit low on oil can seize (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear drive unit
items.note: Free under recall 21V-011. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Intake valves can break in the 2.7L engine (recall)
items.job: Test engine, replace if intake valves fail
items.note: Free under recall 24V-635. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera image blank, frozen or delayed (recalls)
items.job: Update infotainment/camera software
items.note: Free under recall 26V-124 / 25V-315 / 22V-151. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear seat child tether anchor may be weak (recall)
items.job: Replace second-row left seat back frame
items.note: Free under recall 23V-198. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Right headlight may be misaimed or too bright (recall)
items.job: Replace right headlight assembly
items.note: Free under recall 23V-596. Check the VIN first.
